data.summary: The independent validation of the PR-001 Motor claims frequency GLM model reports the following performance metrics: Gini — train of {{m:run_975433:gini.train}}, Gini — test of {{m:run_975433:gini.test}}, Gini — out-of-time (simulated) of {{m:run_975433:gini.oot}}, KS — out-of-time of {{m:run_975433:ks.oot}}, AUC — hold-out of {{m:run_975433:auc.holdout}}, Actual ÷ expected claims — hold-out of {{m:run_975433:ae_ratio.holdout}}, and Poisson deviance explained — hold-out of {{m:run_975433:dev_explained.holdout}}. Parity checks against the legacy implementation show coef_max_abs_diff of {{m:run_975433:coef_max_abs_diff}}, rows_compared of {{m:run_975433:rows_compared}}, and score_max_abs_diff of {{m:run_975433:score_max_abs_diff}}. The review identified a high‑severity finding that gender is used as a pricing factor, and medium‑severity findings concerning a weak ranking in segment veh_body = `CONVT` and the absence of a hold‑out set with all policies fitted and assessed. An additional low‑severity observation notes a manual quarterly upload of the rate table. The overall rating is Requires remediation before continued use.
